name.note: BlackRock's name has the brackets; the ASX lists it as 'iShares S&P 500 AUD Hedged ETF'. 10-for-1 unit split in December 2022 (first post-split NAV 7 Dec 2022).

index.value: S&P 500 Hedged to AUD (BlackRock: S&P 500 Hedged AUD Index Net TR), hedged to AUD
index.note: Holds the US-listed iShares Core S&P 500 ETF (IVV) plus currency forwards that hedge the US dollar back to Australian dollars.

mer.note: Management fee as stated in the PDS

yield.note: BlackRock's '12m Trailing Yield' at 15 Oct 2026: income distributions with ex-dates in the past 12 months divided by the latest NAV. IHVV pays once a year, so this is a single distribution (270.27 cents, ex 1 Jul 2026), which was unusually large: the three before it were 49.5-57.7 cents (about 0.7-0.9% of today's price). The size of the yearly payment swings with currency-hedging gains. Fact sheet: 4.03% at 30 Sep 2026.

franking.note: BlackRock's published 'Franking Level of distributed income' for the year ended 30 Jun 2026 is 0%; US shares carry no franking credits.

listed.note: First day of trading on the ASX (ASX company listing date). Daily prices start here.

inception.note: Fund inception (first unit creation); listed on the ASX 18 Dec 2014. 10-for-1 unit split in Dec 2022: prices and distributions before then are 10x larger per unit.
